root.name: Ruy Lopez: Lucena Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Be7

overview: Black plays 3...Be7 against the Ruy Lopez, delaying ...a6 and ...Nf6. White plays 4.O-O or 4.Bxc6 dxc6 5.d4, and the game often transposes into the Closed Spanish or an Exchange structure. Black is solid but a bit passive.

white_ideas.idea: Play O-O, Re1, c3 and d4
Exchange on c6 for the bishop pair

character.notes: Black postpones ...a6 and ...Nf6; play is a slow Spanish manoeuvring game, usually transposing after 4.O-O Nf6.

gambit.notes: No material is given up on purpose.

soundness.notes: Sound, though 4.Bxc6 dxc6 5.d4 gives White an easy game.

structure.notes: Closed-Spanish type tension; the e4/e5 centre is not settled.

approach.notes: Uncommon move order but a respectable one that strong players meet via transposition.

character.reason: Closed Spanish type: slow, neither sharp nor especially solid.

structure.reason: Centre tension as in the Closed Ruy Lopez.

plans.reason: No plan is specific to the move order.
